providers.reason: Moderna reached new 52-week highs on September 25, fueled by optimism for its oncology pipeline. Positive Phase 3 results for its personalized melanoma vaccine, developed with Merck, have fundamentally shifted the narrative from a pandemic-focused play to a diversified mRNA platform company with major upcoming presentations at the ESMO Congress.
providers.risk: Continued heavy net losses and high Price-to-Sales ratios relative to historical norms make the stock vulnerable to profit-taking.
